reason: BindScope stores Sampled:false annotations for non-analyzed root spans in a map capped at MaxConcurrentRequests (same as permits), and entries leave only on Finish or GC. An analyzed request then gets _dd.iast.enabled=0 and its report is dropped via NewOrphanTaintedSpan, which emits an empty vulnerability span. Independent woven reproducer (dd-trace-go contrib/net/http root spans, all defaults): 2 held sampled-out requests -> 0/10 analyzed victims reported, 10 empty orphan spans; recovery at the same site reports. With 2 background clients under load: 0/90 analyzed victims reported (control with 0 clients: 89/89).
